labels.definition: Divide a system, object, process, or responsibility into independently managed parts that are essential to the stated solution.
Reverse an action, arrangement, sequence, direction, role, or operating condition, and make that reversal essential to the stated solution.
Segmentation and inversion are both essential, not merely mentioned, in the same stated solution.
A different identifiable transformation is central to the solution; record the named alternative.
The displayed information is insufficient, ambiguous, or inconsistent enough that no reliable operator label can be assigned.
